brief.text: Bluerock Private Real Estate Fund (BPRE) generated the largest total transaction value at $40.39 million across three insiders, including a $3.22 million individual purchase by director Ramin Kamfar. Suncrete, Inc. (RMIX) stood out for overall participation, attracting a table-topping four insiders who acquired a combined $1,074,337. Real estate investment trusts and closed-end funds accounted for the largest commitments overall, with BPRE, Six Flags Entertainment Corporation (FUN) at $30.66 million, and Starwood Property Trust (STWD) at $18.73 million driving the three highest cluster totals.
